customer_message.body:
Hello

Before any firm classification: The scaffolding is still up and two sides of the building are unfinished; Even so, the higher rent is due in six weeks; The attachment is labelled an estimate, and the grant has not yet been decided; this is how I remember it.

Regarding “renovation-related increase based on a provisional budget before the works are complete”, for this message: the works completion date remains unresolved; for the request “clarify project completion, final costs and subsidies, and preserve the deadline for the current notice”: the information looks clear but leaves key questions open; on “renovation-related increase based on a provisional budget before the works are complete”, I want a traceable assessment; also unresolved: the final invoices; I would like this position reviewed.

I now need: clarify project completion, final costs and subsidies, and preserve the deadline for the current notice; in particular, I need clarity about the final invoices and which detail must be confirmed before classification.

Before proceeding; Please clarify the works completion date; I can then decide how to proceed.

I first noticed this on 17 August 2025.

Ich kann bei Bedarf auch auf Deutsch antworten.

Best regards
